# RealTools — Free Online Calculators & Tools

> RealTools is a free hub of accurate online calculators and tools. The site provides deterministic calculators for creator ad revenue (AdSense, AdMob, YouTube, TikTok, Twitch, Kick), salary and money planning (8th Pay Commission India, money runway/SWP), and everyday costs (fuel cost) — all computed privately in the browser.

- Company type: Indie Developer / Free Utility
- Products: Google AdMob Revenue Calculator; Google AdSense Revenue Calculator; YouTube Money Calculator; TikTok Money Calculator; Twitch Money Calculator; Kick Earnings Calculator; 8th Pay Commission Salary Calculator (India); Money Runway Calculator; Fuel Cost Calculator (global).
- Services: Creator Revenue Forecasting, Salary Revision Estimation, Savings Runway Planning, Trip Cost Estimation.
- Keywords: admob revenue calculator, adsense revenue calculator, youtube money calculator, tiktok money calculator, 8th pay commission salary calculator, fuel cost calculator, money runway calculator, page rpm calculator, arpdau calculator.
